<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920191_theRebbe_834" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920191_theRebbe_834__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Although the fear of Elul is lower than that of Rosh Hashanah, it has a unique advantage because it is a novel self-nullification achieved when the King is in the field.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, even though in the levels of fear,</t>
    <t s="2">the fear of Elul is lower than the fear of Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="3">for the fear of Elul is a lower fear and the fear of Rosh Hashanah is a higher fear,</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless, there is an advantage in the fear of Elul over the fear of Rosh Hashanah.</t>
    <t s="5">For the fear and self-nullification of Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="6">since then is the time of the revelation of His kingship,</t>
    <t s="7">the fear and self-nullification then are not a novelty.</t>
    <t s="8">For since everything before Him is considered as nothing, and whatever is more before Him is more nothing,</t>
    <t s="9">behold, that Israel are in a state of self-nullification of higher fear during the time of Rosh Hashanah when they are in the palace of His kingship,</t>
    <t s="10">there is no novelty in this.</t>
    <t s="11">[And this is analogous to the self-nullification in Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="12">in which there is no novelty,</t>
    <t s="13">since in Atzilus the revelation of the light of Ein Sof shines.</t>
    <t s="14">And likewise in Atzilus itself,</t>
    <t s="15">the self-nullification in the Sefirah of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="16">in which is the primary self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="17">is not a novelty,</t>
    <t s="18">for in Chochmah is the revelation that He is alone and there is nothing besides Him.</t>
    <t s="19">And all the more so the self-nullification of Kesser,</t>
    <t s="20">for although it is a clear light etc., it is "black" before the Cause of causes,</t>
    <t s="21">for the explanation of "black" is that Kesser is in a state of self-nullification</t>
    <t s="22">(like a black appearance that is not elevated relative to a white appearance)</t>
    <t s="23">relative to Ein Sof which is above Kesser</t>
    <t s="24">(the Cause of causes),</t>
    <t s="25">which is not a novelty,</t>
    <t s="26">since Kesser perceives</t>
    <t s="27">that it is incomparable relative to Ein Sof].</t>
    <t s="28">But the fear and self-nullification in Elul,</t>
    <t s="29">when the King is in the field</t>
    <t s="30">(when His greatness and loftiness are not felt)</t>
    <t s="31">and nevertheless there is the self-nullification of Israel,</t>
    <t s="32">that they accept His kingship upon themselves,</t>
    <t s="33">and moreover they even blow the shofar to arouse fear and trembling</t>
    <t s="34">(so that the acceptance of the kingship will be complete),</t>
    <t s="35">behold this self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="36">even though it is a nullification of the yesh (the tangible self),</t>
    <t s="37">is very precious in the eyes of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="38">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="39">that through the delight of the King from the fact that they go out to greet Him</t>
    <t s="40">(the acceptance of His kingship)</t>
    <t s="41">while He is in the field, it is further added that He receives them all with a pleasant countenance and shows a smiling face to all.</t>
    <t s="42">And it can be added,</t>
    <t s="43">that the advantage in the fear and self-nullification of Elul over the fear and self-nullification of Rosh Hashanah is not only from the aspect of its novelty,</t>
    <t s="44">but also in the matter of the self-nullification itself.</t>
    <t s="45">For the self-nullification that comes through revelation,</t>
    <t s="46">since the self-nullification is because one recognizes and feels the superiority of the revelation</t>
    <t s="47">(which is incomparable relative to him),</t>
    <t s="48">behold, the self-nullification is connected with the existence of the person</t>
    <t s="49">(his awareness).</t>
    <t s="50">But the true essence of self-nullification is in the service of acceptance of the yoke,</t>
    <t s="51">which is like a servant,</t>
    <t s="52">who, because of the yoke of the master that is placed upon him, is compelled to fulfill the will of the master.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The drawing down of the encompassing light of Rosh Hashanah is primarily through the fear and trembling of Elul, which is a self-nullification of lowliness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, we can explain what is said in the maamar, that the drawing down of the encompassing light (makif) of Rosh Hashanah is</t>
    <t s="2">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="3">through the fear and trembling that comes from the shofar blasts of Elul,</t>
    <t s="4">for this, that through the trembling</t>
    <t s="5">(and "trembling at His word")</t>
    <t s="6">is the drawing down of the encompassing light</t>
    <t s="7">(Beis),</t>
    <t s="8">is</t>
    <t s="9">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="10">when the trembling is in a manner of self-nullification and lowliness,</t>
    <t s="11">"poor and contrite of spirit."</t>
    <t s="12">And as explained in the maamar, that the more a person humbles himself,</t>
    <t s="13">the encompassing light that is drawn down is a higher encompassing light.</t>
    <t s="14">Therefore, the primary drawing down of the encompassing light is through the fear and trembling of Elul,</t>
    <t s="15">for the fear and trembling of Rosh Hashanah is through feeling the revelation from above,</t>
    <t s="16">and the self-nullification through the feeling of revelation is not in a manner of lowliness,</t>
    <t s="17">and the primary matter of "poor and contrite of spirit,"</t>
    <t s="18">self-nullification in a manner of lowliness,</t>
    <t s="19">is in the fear and trembling of Elul.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The advantage of Elul's fear over Rosh Hashanah's is that it comes through Israel's service, whose root is in Atzmus, thus drawing down Atzmus itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And we can add further explanation regarding the advantage of the fear of Elul over the fear of Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="1">for since the fear and self-nullification of Elul come through the service of Israel,</t>
    <t s="2">"I am for my Beloved,"</t>
    <t s="3">and the root of Israel is in the Atzmus (Essence),</t>
    <t s="4">therefore,</t>
    <t s="5">the drawing down that comes through this fear and self-nullification is a drawing down of Atzmus.</t>
    <t s="6">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="7">that this is the inner reason for the fact that from the lower fear of Elul they later come on Rosh Hashanah to the higher fear,</t>
    <t s="8">for through the fear of Elul there is a drawing down of Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="9">and through this are drawn down</t>
    <t s="10">(afterward)</t>
    <t s="11">also the revelations.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
